text:
ellie-cs: Quick flag for NovaQuant account health — onboarding metrics show p95 creeping up (~+130ms) and p99 spikes on east-coast traffic during morning batch windows. Renewal check-in in 7 days; theyre asking for a short plan to show were actively reducing tail latency and cost. Suggest a regional fallback + lightweight int8 path for non-interactive batch calls, plus short canary. Anyone available to own?

matt-eng: I can take the routing piece. Proposal: create a regional rule that routes traffic from us-east-1 to a high-throughput pool with an int8-compatible variant for batch endpoints only. Keep interactive endpoints on the full-precision model. Start 10% batch traffic -> 40% over 24h if quality holds. Also add a KV prefix TTL tweak for those batch prefixes to reduce cold-cache p99.

kim-ml: int8 for batch-only is lower risk. We still need a short eval focused on multi-turn and long prefixes because their product mixes short user prompts with longer context occasionally. Ill assemble ~40 examples extracted from their slow traces (anonymized) and run quality diffs against baseline. Expect results in ~8h.

ops-bot: perf-bot: anomaly detected: novaquant-v2 p99 spike on 2026-03-21T08:12Z for region us-east-1. Auto-generated report saved to /perf/reports/novaquant/2026-03-21.

sam-devex: Ill draft an SDK snippet so the CS team can toggle the regional rule and a short one-pager for Nova execs explaining what were doing and expected impact (latency + cost). Also will spin up a dev-canary namespace so engineers can validate without touching prod.

stephen-sre: Add SLO gates for the canary: require p99 improvement >= 80ms for routed batch traffic and error-rate <= baseline + 0.5%. Automated rollback at 10-minute window if either condition fails. Ill create the alert channel and a read-only dashboard showing per-region p50/p95/p99 and cost/1k.

nova-pm: Appreciate the quick turnaround. Two asks: 1) if we see good wins, can we show a 48h trend for the renewal meeting? 2) please prioritize a short bullet list for execs (no more than 5 bullets).

matt-eng: Yes to both. Plan timeline: canary policy out in ~3h, eval results in ~8h, dashboard + runbook in ~12h. If eval looks good we ramp batch routing 10->40% over 24h. If quality dips we rollback and open a follow-up for more targeted quant calibration.

kim-ml: Note on calibration: if we see systematic drift on certain prompt prefixes, we can hybridize by routing those prefixes to full-precision while keeping others on int8. Ill tag any flagged prefixes in the report.

ellie-cs: Action items recap: matt (regional routing + KV TTL for batch), kim (eval + prefix tagging), sam (SDK snippet + exec one-pager + dev canary), stephen (SLOs + alerts + dashboard), ellie (coordinate renewal deliverable). Ill update Nova and post the exec bullets once sam and kim have initial outputs.

(emoji reactions: :rocket: from matt-eng, :eyes: from kim-ml, :thumbsup: from nova-pm)
